name: Standard Push-Up
instructions: Keep a flat plank line and lower your chest with slow, controlled movement.
video_prompt: Cinematic fitness tutorial video of a young man performing standard bodyweight push-ups on a clean floor, proper flat plank form, slow and controlled movement, side angle view, high quality.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Keep your heels flat and lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
video_prompt: Step-by-step fitness demonstration of bodyweight squats, proper form with heels flat on the floor, thighs parallel to the ground at the bottom, front-side angle view, clean gym or home studio setting.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Raise your hips into an inverted V and lower your head toward the floor with control.
video_prompt: Fitness tutorial video showing a man doing pike push-ups, hips raised high in an inverted V-shape position, lowering head toward the floor with controlled movement, gym background.

name: Australian Pull-Up / Inverted Row
instructions: Use a sturdy table or low bar, keep your body straight, and pull your chest toward the support.
video_prompt: Home calisthenics demonstration of an Australian pull-up or inverted row using a sturdy table or low bar, body straight, pulling chest to the bar, clear instructional angle.

name: Plank Hold
instructions: Keep a straight line from head to heels and brace your core throughout the hold.
video_prompt: Fitness demonstration of a forearm plank hold, straight body alignment from head to heels, engaged core, stable and clean background, slow motion close-up.
